title: Mitophagy-related gene signatures predict prognosis and therapeutic response in hepatocellular carcinoma.
snippet: Mitophagy, a selective form of autophagy, has been implicated in tumor progression and therapeutic resistance; however, its prognostic significance in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains unclear.
